title: lde run profile data
description: Sampled profiler data written by `lde run --json <file>` (a bare `--json` implies profiling and defaults to profile.json; `--profile --json` also prints the text report).

version.description: Schema version of the profile data

intervalMs.description: Sampling interval in milliseconds; the profiler takes one sample per interval

total.description: Total samples collected during the run

totalMs.description: Approximate profiled wall time in milliseconds (total * intervalMs)

vmstates.description: Sample counts per LuaJIT VM state

hotspots.description: Functions sorted by sample count, descending

loc.description: Function name (or chunk label) of the hotspot

stacks.description: Folded call stacks (frames joined by ';') mapped to sample counts; the input the flamegraph tree is built from
